grammarFocus: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of。
title: Should Schools Start Later? A Debate in Maple Town
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是真实考试。请根据文章内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
A. In the small town of Maple Town, a group of parents, teachers, and students met last week to discuss a new idea: starting the school day one hour later. The meeting was organized by the local school board, and more than 200 people attended. The main question was simple: would a later start time help students learn better, or would it cause more problems than it solves?

B. Ms. Chen, a science teacher at Maple Town High School, spoke first. She said, "Although many students go to bed early, they still feel tired in the morning because their bodies need more sleep during their teenage years." She explained that research shows teenagers naturally fall asleep later at night and wake up later in the morning. Because of this, a 7:30 a.m. start time may be too early for them. She added, "While some students can wake up early without difficulty, most of them cannot." Ms. Chen believes that a later start time, such as 8:30 a.m., would allow students to get enough sleep and improve their attention in class.

C. However, not everyone agreed. Mr. Patel, a parent of two children at the school, raised a practical concern. He said, "Because many parents start work at 8:00 a.m., they depend on the school bus to take their children to school. If school starts later, parents may be late for work." He also pointed out that after-school activities, such as sports and music lessons, would finish later in the evening. While he understood the benefits of more sleep, he worried about the inconvenience for families.

D. A student named Lily also spoke. She said, "I often feel sleepy in my first class because I have to wake up at 6:15 a.m. to catch the bus. Although I try to go to bed early, I sometimes have too much homework." Lily suggested that the school could provide a later bus for students who live far away. She also mentioned that some students have part-time jobs after school and need time for homework.

E. The school board listened to all the opinions. They decided to try a pilot program for one month. During this month, school will start at 8:15 a.m. instead of 7:30 a.m. The board will collect data on student attendance, grades, and how students feel. They will also ask parents and teachers for feedback. After the pilot program, the board will meet again to decide whether to make the change permanent.

F. Dr. Wang, a sleep expert from the local university, gave a presentation at the meeting. She said, "While some people can adapt to early schedules, teenagers' internal clocks are different. Because of changes in their bodies, they need about 8 to 10 hours of sleep each night, but many get only 6 or 7." She recommended that schools consider later start times, but she also warned that any change should be made carefully. "Although a later start time can help, it is not a magic solution. Students also need good sleep habits at home," she said.

G. The meeting ended with a vote. About 60% of the people supported the pilot program, while 40% were against it. The school board president, Mr. Lee, said, "We are happy that so many people shared their views. Although we cannot please everyone, we believe this trial is a good way to find out what works best for our students." The pilot program will begin next month.

grammar.title: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of
grammar.explanation: 在段落中，主题句（topic sentence）概括主要观点，支持句（supporting sentences）提供细节、例子或原因。although 和 while 用于引导让步状语从句，表示“虽然，尽管”；because 后接句子，because of 后接名词或名词短语。
grammar.example: Although many students go to bed early, they still feel tired in the morning because their bodies need more sleep during their teenage years.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ it was raining, we still went for a walk.
questions.explanation: 这里表示“虽然下雨，我们还是去散步了”，用 Although 引导让步状语从句。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She was late ______ the heavy traffic.
questions.explanation: the heavy traffic 是名词短语，所以用 because of。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ some students can wake up early, most cannot.
questions.explanation: 这里用 While 表示对比，“虽然有些学生能早起，但大多数不能”。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a good topic sentence for a paragraph about the benefits of later school start times?
options: Later school start times can improve students' sleep and attention.
Many students take the bus to school.
The school board met last week.
answers: Later school start times can improve students' sleep and attention.
questions.explanation: 主题句应概括段落的主要观点，该选项直接点明推迟上学时间的好处。
